title: Layer gate construction
statement: Let $g$ be a gate whose argument list has no repetitions and whose argument list has length one whenever $g$ is a NOT gate. For any domain $D$ and any assignment of a vertex of $D$ to each argument in the list, the construction gives a gate with values in $	ext{Fin}(2)$, wired to those assigned vertices. Its operation is $x\mapsto 1-x(0)$ for a NOT gate, and the product of the input values for either an AND or an OR gate.
hypotheses_covered: The argument list has no repetitions.
